title: Local Bakery Wins Regional Award
text: A small family bakery has won the regional award for best community business. The owners started the shop twelve years ago with just two employees. Today the bakery employs 18 people and supplies bread to several nearby cafes. Judges praised its use of local flour and its free bread program for shelters. The owners said the award will help them open a second shop next spring. Customers lined up early on Monday to congratulate the team.

title: River Cleanup Draws Hundreds of Volunteers
text: More than 400 volunteers gathered on Saturday to clean a three-mile stretch of the Marlow River. They collected over two tons of trash, including tires, bottles, and plastic bags. Organizers said this was the largest turnout in the event's history. Local businesses donated gloves, bags, and refreshments for the volunteers. The city will use the collected data to plan new trash barriers along the banks. Another cleanup is scheduled for the fall.
